maria: Heads-up — sapphire-mini-int4 canary (streaming funcall) is showing an uptick in parse failures right around chunk boundaries. float32 baseline clean.

tyler: numbers? any pattern?

maria: about 5.1% fail rate on our structured-output suite (n=5000). baseline 0.4%. failures spike when the output contains nested arrays and the stream splits inside an array literal.

jon: can you paste a clipped runtime log?

maria: sure, from postproc stderr:```
2026-03-23 02:12:01,005 postproc ERROR parse: JSONDecodeError: Unterminated string starting at: line 1 column 193 (char 192)
...out snippet...
{"tool":"lookup","params":[{"id":"r-123","fields":["title","date","url"]}, {"id":"r-124","fields":["title","date"]}]}
<<stream truncated>>
```

nina: that truncation in the middle of the second object's fields array is the smoking gun. Looks like chunk boundaries are splitting tokens right after a quote.

tyler: two product-safe ideas: (A) runtime one-shot repair — on parse failure, try append heuristics like `]}`, `"}` pairs, reparse once; tag telemetry `repair_attempted`/`repair_ok`; CPU cap 40ms. (B) during PTQ canaries, add a short sentinel token emitted by the model after the JSON object, e.g. `\n<<JSON_OK>>\n`, so parsers wait.

maria: I prefer runtime repair for customers, but worried about silent semantics change if repair mutates args. We must diff pre/post and log any changed fields.

jon: NDJSON is also an option for multi-tool streaming — each call as separate line avoids partial-array splits. But it's a product-level proto change.

canary-bot: run 7071234567-A done: baseline success=94.9% n=5000; sentinel-probe success=99.6% n=5000; repair-probe (1 retry append heuristics) success=98.3% n=5000.

ops-bot: big win for sentinel in canary. Ops recommendation: do NOT change customer prompts by default. Implement runtime repair as opt-in per-tenant, opt-out default for Dedicated/Private.

tyler: ok I'll prototype a tiny patch: on parse exception, perform: try appending `"}` then `]}` then `}}` with single reparse attempt; record `repair_kind` and `repair_delta` (string diff) in telemetry. Limit to one attempt and 50ms extra.

maria: launching a 15k-run overnight with three arms: baseline, sentinel, repair-patch. Will share aggregated counts + a few representative repaired payloads.

jon: please include an advisory check: if repair changes an arg value (not just closing chars), mark as `repair_semantic_change=true` and surface to manual audit table.

nina: also test kvcache prefix scenarios — observed spike when prefix > 900 tokens. Include prefix-length slice in results.

canary-bot: scheduled followup 7071234567-summary -> 2026-03-24 09:00 PT

ops-bot: runbook note updated: "quant canary parsing failures: prefer sentinel for canaries; implement runtime one-shot repair with strict caps and telemetry; opt-outs for Dedicated/Private."

maria: thanks team. if repair path looks risky we can push sentinel into the onboarding docs for PTQ models only. will post results tomorrow. :+1:
